//! The `greet` use case's failures.

use crate::outbound::names::errors::NamesError;

/// Why `greet` failed.
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum GreetError {
    /// No name was given.
    #[error("no name was given")]
    Empty,
    /// The names port refused the name.
    #[error("the names port refused the name")]
    Names(#[from] NamesError),
}
